data.name: Eeshta
data.gender_notes: Eeshta is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'Eesha' meaning 'wisdom, knowledge, learning'. In Hindu mythology, Eeshta is the goddess of wisdom and learning, often depicted with a rosary and a book. The name Eeshta carries the meaning “Wisdom, Knowledge, Learning” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eeshta usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom, knowledge, learning and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Eeshta belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wisdom, Knowledge, Learning.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eeshta total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
